selection.description: Normalize every currently draftable non-talent class ability whose first rank is learned at level 20 or earlier. The native rank family is kept as profile/anchor source data and is replaced by one 201xxx card.

scaling.notes: Native WoW ranks are semantic anchors. Specialized profiles keep fields with their real meaning instead of treating every effect as an anonymous min/max pair. Periodic damage is interpolated as the integer per-tick value AzerothCore actually executes; the visible total is always derived from that tick amount and the runtime tick count, so server and tooltip cannot diverge through integer division. Native anchors also retain dot_total as a reference invariant and must reproduce it exactly. Missing player levels are interpolated. Generic effect curves remain as a fallback for profiles not specialized yet. Spell power, crit, haste, buffs/debuffs and target modifiers remain normal AzerothCore mechanics and are not baked into the base level curves.
